provenance.analysis: descriptive only; no causal, null-model, centrality, or spectral inference
provenance.populationBand: population >=10, top five most-observed exact population counts per seed

notes: Raw encounter episodes and rolling-window edge lifetimes are distinct quantities.
Threshold episode counts are non-monotone because wider thresholds can join/fragment observations differently; report cumulative exposure alongside counts.
Rolling windows describe retained contact memory; they do not define encounter-duration cutoffs.
Trajectory has 2D x,y,vx,vy,heading,radius; it does not contain z.
Connector local counts and colony mean neighbor counts are recomputed from all positions at the same exact 60 Hz trajectory frame; thresholds are center distance <=0.022 and <=0.085.
Reported quantiles use linear interpolation at position (n - 1) * p (Type 7 / common R default); values are descriptive.
Population start is the t=0 trajectory frame, not the first 1 Hz timeline sample.

measures.instantaneousPairs: edgeCount from proximity graph at k=2; not causal
measures.occupancy: instantaneous 8x8 grid normalized entropy and top-10%-cell ant share
